Round 6 is finished, with Track S (the five bug and docs items) and Track U (SRW-10 navigation) both implemented in the real store. I'm not claiming any of it passes; C still has to verify. A context-watch restart interrupted the last session just before it ended. This session changed no source; it only re-ran every check from ┬º9 of the task.

**Checks, re-run this session:**
- Tests: 761 of 761 passed (49 files).
- Typecheck (`tsc`): no errors.
- Biome: no errors on my files or across `./app`. `./app` still has 218 warnings and 1 info note.
- Build: passed.
- The four protected files are unchanged (hashes match).
- `Header.tsx` is identical to HEAD and to `354e341`.
- On top of root's checkpoint commit `c5ed47b` there are 11 uncommitted files (443 lines added, 59 removed), all inside my allowed list. Git warns that LF will become CRLF in these files; that is only the line-ending setting and the files themselves are fine.

**What was done:**
- **S1 (one edit gesture at a time):** a second pointer can no longer start an edit while another drag is running. A stale drag from the same pointer is cancelled cleanly. Mute, Solo, Volume, the edit buttons and adding from the library are refused during a drag. As a safety net, a drag also ends if the release only reaches the window or the window loses focus. The 7 new tests for this failed on the round-5 code before the fix.
- **S2 (video escalation):** the minimum gap between escalations is now 600 ms, and that rule now has unit tests.
- **S3 (Play past the end):** Play is refused with the new message when the playhead is beyond the project end, so the insert position is kept.
- **S4 (small UI bugs):** library list titles are distinct, the drag ghost's label stays inside its box with the refusal reason in the footer, the paste refusal names the time, and the Shift hint wording changed.
- **S5 (docs):** docs 012, 013 and 014 corrected; doc 015 written.
- **SRW-10 (navigation):** the navigation maths is in a new pure module (`view.ts`). A new overview strip sits left of the video box without adding height. Also added: ruler drag (a click seeks on release), Ctrl+wheel, `+`/`ΓêÆ`, Z/X zoom history, Fit and Follow.
- The real design-philosopher and code-reviewer were run; their rulings are quoted in the report and their findings were handled.
- The concrete findings from root's checkpoint review were addressed, except the ones listed under follow-ups below.

- **RF6-2:** I ran only 7 drift runs: 3 passed, 2 were invalid and 1 failed by 0.0009 before a Follow performance fix. The analysis of the seventh was lost. I did not run the other video layout, the loop runs or RF5-3.
- **G6-R (regression list):** not run by me. G6-3 (anonymous access) got only a sanity check. In my run, anonymous `/api/studio-token` returned 400, where C saw 401 in round 5; I didn't re-judge that.
- S1, S3, S4, S5 and SRW-10 have no known gaps from my browser runs. Real mouse, touch and trackpad checks stay on the Tech Lead's list.
